    {
      "name": "dangerous_permission_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted count of high-risk Android permissions commonly abused (SMS, phone state, contacts, location, audio, camera, install packages). Provides linear severity score.",
      "value_range": [0, 15],
      "feature_family": "weighted_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Direct linear projection of risk-relevant permissions; smooth margin contributor for SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(`android.permission.SEND_SMS`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.RECEIVE_SMS`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.READ_SMS`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.CALL_PHONE`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.PROCESS_INCOMING_CALLS`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.READ_CONTACTS`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.CAMERA`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.READ_LOGS`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW`).astype(float)"
    },
    {
      "name": "sms_telephony_intensity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of SMS and telephony related permissions indicating communication/interception capability.",
      "value_range": [0, 6],
      "feature_family": "weighted_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Concentrated semantic axis useful for linear separation of communication-abusing apps.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(`android.permission.SEND_SMS`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.RECEIVE_SMS`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.READ_SMS`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.CALL_PHONE`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.PROCESS_INCOMING_CALLS`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE`).astype(float)"
    },
    {
      "name": "location_tracking_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Number of location-related permissions requested (fine, coarse, mock, extra commands).",
      "value_range": [0, 4],
      "feature_family": "weighted_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth continuous signal of tracking capability; linearly separable.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(`android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.ACCESS_MOCK_LOCATION`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.ACCESS_LOCATION_EXTRA_COMMANDS`).astype(float)"
    },
    {
      "name": "storage_filesystem_access_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of storage and filesystem related permissions indicating data access scope.",
      "value_range": [0, 3],
      "feature_family": "weighted_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear-friendly composite of related access permissions.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(`android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.MOUNT_UNMOUNT_FILESYSTEMS`).astype(float)"
    },
    {
      "name": "network_connectivity_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Count of network/connectivity permissions: internet, wifi state/change, network state, bluetooth, nfc.",
      "value_range": [0, 7],
      "feature_family": "weighted_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear separator for network-active apps.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(`android.permission.INTERNET`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.ACCESS_WIFI_STATE`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.CHANGE_WIFI_STATE`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.CHANGE_NETWORK_STATE`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.BLUETOOTH`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.NFC`).astype(float)"
    },
    {
      "name": "account_credential_access_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Count of account/credential/profile-related permissions.",
      "value_range": [0, 5],
      "feature_family": "weighted_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures identity-data access dimension as a linear feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(`android.permission.GET_ACCOUNTS`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.AUTHENTICATE_ACCOUNTS`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.USE_CREDENTIALS`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.READ_PROFILE`).astype(float)"
    },
    {
      "name": "launcher_badge_oem_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Count of launcher/badge OEM-specific permissions, often correlated with widely distributed app frameworks.",
      "value_range": [0, 15],
      "feature_family": "weighted_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear composite distinguishing OEM-integration heavy apps.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(`com.sonyericsson.home.permission.BROADCAST_BADGE`).astype(float) + (`com.huawei.android.launcher.permission.CHANGE_BADGE`).astype(float) + (`com.oppo.launcher.permission.READ_SETTINGS`).astype(float) + (`com.android.launcher.permission.READ_SETTINGS`).astype(float) + (`com.majeur.launcher.permission.UPDATE_BADGE`).astype(float) + (`com.anddoes.launcher.permission.UPDATE_COUNT`).astype(float) + (`com.htc.launcher.permission.READ_SETTINGS`).astype(float) + (`com.sonymobile.home.permission.PROVIDER_INSERT_BADGE`).astype(float) + (`com.sec.android.provider.badge.permission.READ`).astype(float) + (`com.sec.android.provider.badge.permission.WRITE`).astype(float) + (`com.huawei.android.launcher.permission.WRITE_SETTINGS`).astype(float) + (`com.oppo.launcher.permission.WRITE_SETTINGS`).astype(float) + (`com.huawei.android.launcher.permission.READ_SETTINGS`).astype(float) + (`me.everything.badger.permission.BADGE_COUNT_READ`).astype(float) + (`me.everything.badger.permission.BADGE_COUNT_WRITE`).astype(float)"
    },
    {
      "name": "background_persistence_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Permissions that allow apps to persist or run in background: boot completed, wake lock, foreground service, receive user present, restart packages, kill background processes.",
      "value_range": [0, 6],
      "feature_family": "weighted_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear axis for persistent/auto-start behavior often abused.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(`android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.WAKE_LOCK`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.RECEIVE_USER_PRESENT`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.RESTART_PACKAGES`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.KILL_BACKGROUND_PROCESSES`).astype(float)"
    },
    {
      "name": "dangerous_to_total_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of dangerous permission count over total permission count + 1 (smoothed). Captures concentration of risk.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth normalized score robust to app size, ideal for SVM margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((`android.permission.SEND_SMS`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.RECEIVE_SMS`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.READ_SMS`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.CALL_PHONE`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.READ_CONTACTS`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.CAMERA`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.READ_LOGS`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW`).astype(float)) / (1.0 + (`android.permission.GET_ACCOUNTS`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.INTERNET`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.ACCESS_WIFI_STATE`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.WAKE_LOCK`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.VIBRATE`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED`).astype(float) + (`com.google.android.c2dm.permission.RECEIVE`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.GET_TASKS`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.SEND_SMS`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.RECEIVE_SMS`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.READ_SMS`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.CALL_PHONE`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.READ_CONTACTS`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.CAMERA`).astype(float))"
    },
    {
      "name": "rare_permission_indicator_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment: count of rare permissions held by an app (permissions with low overall prevalence in training data such as PROCESS_INCOMING_CALLS, FOREGROUND_SERVICE, WRITE_USE_APP_FEATURE_SURVEY, ANDROID READ_PHONE_STATE duplicate, AMAZON messaging, IAP BILLING). Higher score indicates unusual permission profile.",
      "value_range": [0, 6],
      "feature_family": "semantic_rarity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear discriminator highlighting atypical permission combinations, smooth integer score.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(`android.permission.PROCESS_INCOMING_CALLS`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE`).astype(float) + (`samsung.providers.context.WRITE_USE_APP_FEATURE_SURVEY`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE`).astype(float) + (`com.amazon.device.messaging.permission.RECEIVE`).astype(float) + (`com.sec.android.iap.permission.BILLING`).astype(float)"
    },
    {
      "name": "benign_baseline_permission_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic judgment: count of permissions commonly used by typical legitimate apps (internet, network state, wifi state, wake lock, vibrate, c2dm receive, GET_ACCOUNTS, RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED). Helps offset alarm from large permission counts when they reflect normal app behavior.",
      "value_range": [0, 8],
      "feature_family": "semantic_baseline",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Acts as a negative-direction linear feature representing typical app behavior baseline.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(`android.permission.INTERNET`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.ACCESS_WIFI_STATE`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.WAKE_LOCK`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.VIBRATE`).astype(float) + (`com.google.android.c2dm.permission.RECEIVE`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.GET_ACCOUNTS`).astype(float) + (`android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED`).astype(float)"
    }
  ]
